BLS OEWS · May 2025

US occupational wages, compared by metro.

In BLS OEWS May 2025, Software Developers have published annual medians of $134,120 in Austin, $134,380 in Chicago, $167,280 in Seattle. WageGrid republishes those estimates for 25 occupations in 3 metros and does not invent wages.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.

How to read a page

Each metro × occupation page shows employment, mean and median wages, and the location quotient from OEWS May 2025. Hourly figures are omitted when BLS publishes the occupation annual-only (common for teachers). Compare the same job across the three metros, or switch occupations inside one metro.

Questions

What wages does WageGrid publish?

WageGrid republishes BLS OEWS May 2025 estimates for 25 occupations in Austin, Chicago, and Seattle. Example published annual medians for Software Developers: Austin $134,120, Chicago $134,380, Seattle $167,280.

Does WageGrid invent missing wages?

No. Every dollar amount is an official OEWS estimate. BLS suppressions stay blank. Cite BLS OEWS when quoting a figure.

Is this legal or career advice?

These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice. Cite BLS OEWS when quoting a wage.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
